label: safe_window
description: Sunny, well-mixed air. No inversion, steady NW wind inside 3-10 mph, little shear.

description: Inversion forms about half an hour before sunset as the wind dies.

label: hidden_inversion
description: PRIMARY DEMO. Easterly 4-5 mph breeze at ground level looks fine, but air at 30 ft is 3-5 F warmer and blowing from the south at about 9 mph, toward the school.

label: safe_window
description: Inversion has burned off. Steady NW wind, small differences between heights.

label: sensor_suspect
description: One impossible 5 ft temperature reading (139.8 F). Tests input validation.

label: application_A2
description: High-volatility product applied. Inversion starts near the end of the job.

description: Inversion persists for hours after application A2, with 5 ft wind under 3 mph for much of the evening. Vapor drift risk after spraying.

label: overcast_night_no_inversion
description: Cloudy, breezy night. No inversion forms, showing that night is not always unsafe.

label: application_A3
description: Conditions deteriorate during spraying. 30 ft wind passes 10 mph around 10:00.

label: hidden_high_wind_aloft
description: 5 ft wind is 7-9 mph and looks fine. 30 ft wind is 11-15 mph.

label: high_wind_all_heights
description: Pre-frontal wind above 10 mph at every height.

label: rain_and_wind_shift
description: Light rain. Wind swings from S to NW between about 14:00 and 14:45 as the front passes.

label: evening_inversion
description: Skies clear behind the front and an inversion builds while the wind is still easing.

label: calm_inversion
description: Cold, clear, nearly calm. Inversion until mid-morning.

label: sensor_missing
description: 30 ft sensor stops reporting. The 5 and 15 ft sensors still show the inversion.

label: low_wind_no_inversion
description: Inversion is gone but the air is light and variable, under 3 mph at 5 ft.

label: safe_window
description: Steady NW wind inside 3-10 mph, no inversion, little shear.

label: sensor_stale
